state_semantics: done = task acceptance verified; remote synchronization and CI are separate observations. Owner-gate tasks cannot be done without owner evidence.

tasks.title: Reconcile workspace and import the handoff
scope: Inspect existing instructions, branch, dirty state, Git remotes and current remote refs; compare current code with BASELINE.json without resetting newer work.
Preview and apply only additive handoff files on a dedicated feature branch. Resolve an existing AGENTS.md by an explicit manual merge, never by overwriting it.
Record actual environment and branch in STATUS.md; validate the task graph; make the first reviewed commit/push checkpoint and prepare the draft PR.
acceptance: No application file or original asset changes.
No unknown local work is stashed, removed or staged.
Imported plan is internally valid; final feature-branch SHA and sync result are reported honestly.

tasks.title: Characterize the current application with safe fixtures
scope: Build the synthetic fixture generator and a versioned test-environment inventory.
Capture legacy observations for ordinary image/video inputs and the suspected collision, frame, failed-first duplicate and weak-output cases.
For dangerous nested-output behavior use mocked planning first or a disposable account/VM; never run it against the real Pictures tree.
acceptance: No claimed legacy reproduction lacks a command, version and output transcript.
Fixture source bytes and declared properties are independently inspected.
Current known defects are recorded separately from passing regression tests.

tasks.title: Introduce minimal test seams and early Windows checks
scope: Move only the top-level orchestration needed for test isolation into callable helpers; keep both public entry points and invocation forms.
Inject an internal test destination/process runner so tests cannot touch real Pictures; do not add a new user configuration system.
Add a Pester runner and a minimal Windows PowerShell 5.1/PowerShell 7 CI matrix with real version reporting and safe dependency installation.
acceptance: Ordinary fixture behavior is unchanged outside known defects.
Loading functions for unit tests does not execute the application or terminate the test host.
CI runs real tests and fails when a deliberate assertion is broken; no empty-success workflow.

tasks.title: Validate inputs, root paths and ImageMagick before work
scope: Validate argument count, source FileSystem directory and positive Int64 byte cap with friendly errors.
Normalize drive/UNC roots without losing root semantics; resolve the real ImageMagick application and record version/delegates.
Check a patched supported ImageMagick build and codecs needed by the batch, destination writability and practical space; no application output on basic setup failure.
acceptance: Both existing positional calls still work.
Bad arguments and missing ImageMagick fail before run-directory creation.
Per-format gaps have useful diagnoses; video-only handling is explicitly documented and tested.

tasks.title: Protect traversal and allocate unique run directories
scope: Define source/destination containment with canonical roots and path-segment comparisons.
Reject unsafe nesting before writes for the first hardened version; do not silently fall back to another directory.
Allocate collision-resistant no-reuse run directories and protect generated work/report namespaces.
acceptance: Pictures, its parents and drive-root input cannot cause destination self-ingestion.
Two concurrent/timestamp-identical launches never share a run directory.
Lookalike path prefixes do not count as containment.

tasks.title: Plan collision-free output names before conversion
scope: Build a deterministic per-directory output-name reservation plan including file/directory conflicts and generated names.
Keep the legacy basename when unique; use source-extension suffixes and checked numeric suffixes for collisions.
Retain a complete source-to-output mapping for later reporting; final writes must not overwrite external arrivals.
acceptance: photo.jpg/photo.png/photo.heic all receive distinct planned names.
An existing photo__png.jpeg input and directory named photo.jpeg cannot break the scheme.
Plans are identical across input enumeration orders and both PowerShell versions.

tasks.title: Validate temporary outputs and finalize without overwriting
scope: Write conversion attempts to owned neutral temporary files, never the intended final name.
Require a successful native outcome plus nonempty single-frame JPEG full decode, positive dimensions and size measurement before committing.
Stage video copies too; check completion/source stability and no-overwrite finalization. Retain only owned partials on unexpected interruption.
acceptance: Zero-length, malformed, stale, wrong-format, nonzero-exit and truncated outputs never count as success.
A successful first attempt cannot be reused accidentally after a later failed attempt.
Video bytes match inputs in regression tests; unrelated destination files are never replaced.

tasks.title: Make heuristic duplicate handling deterministic and success-based
scope: Sort candidate paths deterministically and register a duplicate only after verified output finalization.
Keep the lightweight filename/timestamp heuristic; require matching length before a skip as the documented extra guard.
Record the retained successful source/output for every skip; do not add always-on hashing or remove originals.
acceptance: A failed first candidate cannot suppress a later usable candidate.
Different lengths with the same filename/timestamp do not skip.
Same-key/same-length collisions remain explicitly documented as a heuristic limitation.

tasks.title: Close the output-safety milestone
scope: Run the combined safe-output tests and inspect all finalization/collision paths.
Verify source content and creation/modified times on synthetic fixtures; include two-run isolation.
Review the entire milestone diff for scope creep and leave a synchronized evidence checkpoint.
acceptance: All mandatory M1 cases pass on available target shells; untested target environments are explicit blockers to full milestone acceptance.
No output loss/overwrite remains in the covered collision scenarios.
No accidental runtime dependency or public-interface rewrite was introduced.

tasks.title: Implement deliberate first-frame and first-page handling
scope: Select one logical first displayed frame for animated images and one first page for multipage documents.
Respect canvas placement and orientation without overlaying unrelated pages; do not rely on implicit numbered JPEG output.
Record source frame/page counts and omitted content, including codec-dependent cases.
acceptance: Exactly one intended JPEG is produced per selected source and no numbered-file escape occurs.
Multipage TIFF uses the first page, never page stacking.
Dropped frames/pages are visible in reports without pretending animation is preserved.

tasks.title: Convert colour profiles before metadata removal
scope: Inspect embedded ICC profiles before stripping and use a verified sRGB conversion path.
Define tagged/untagged RGB and CMYK behavior, alpha compositing order and malformed-profile handling; retain auto-orientation.
Use redistributable, provenance-recorded reference profiles/fixtures; measure against a colour-managed reference.
acceptance: Profiled source colours meet documented tolerant reference comparisons before lossy-JPEG effects are assessed.
GPS/EXIF/XMP/IPTC and unwanted profiles are absent from final images according to the declared policy.
Unrecoverable colour/profile ambiguity is warned or failed explicitly rather than silently misrepresented.

tasks.title: Make filesystem and native filename handling literal-safe
scope: Test both PowerShell and ImageMagick parsing layers for difficult input/output paths.
Use supported literal-output behavior or neutral temporary names plus filesystem rename; stage ambiguous input names under a neutral controlled name when needed.

Handle Unicode, local long paths and lexical drive/UNC-root boundaries without introducing shell evaluation or filename-format expansion. Live network-share validation/support is outside owner-approved scope (D35).
acceptance: Percent and bracket filenames retain their literal identity in final names.
Quoted spaces, ampersands, apostrophes and Unicode work through the launcher as well as direct calls.
Unsupported long-path environments fail clearly without truncation or source changes.

tasks.title: Clarify byte caps and benchmark quality without silent default changes
scope: Document the 1,048,576-byte default and ensure the ImageMagick extent string represents the intended number of bytes.
Separate compliant and valid-above-target outcomes while keeping the 100→50 scale sequence and existing best-effort behavior initially.
Measure representative synthetic/copy quality and timings; propose algorithm changes only with owner-visible evidence.
acceptance: Exact byte counts govern status, not MB display labels.
Above-target valid JPEGs are warnings, not plain OK results.
No default quality/resize change is slipped into a reporting fix.

tasks.title: Capture useful errors and remove indiscriminate fallback
scope: Capture bounded stdout/stderr and native exit information separately without turning known harmless warnings into random PowerShell exceptions.
Classify missing codec, damaged input, denied access, resource exhaustion and recoverable failures.
Retry only justified transient failures with a bound; preserve promised alpha/background treatment on every attempt.
acceptance: Real failure details reach the log without flooding the console.
A missing codec is not retried at every scale.
No fallback silently removes required transparency handling or accepts nonzero output as ordinary success.

tasks.title: Close the conversion-correctness milestone
scope: Run representative colour, frame, literal-name, orientation and sizing cases together.
Collect real comparison artifacts from approved fixtures and document any codec/build-specific variation.
Review the default behavior against the baseline contract and synchronize evidence.
acceptance: Mandatory conversion cases pass on required test configurations or remain explicitly blocked.
Colour/quality evidence is attached to the tested implementation revision, not to a different worktree.
Lossy output is not described as a lossless archive.

tasks.title: Recover from inaccessible folders and expose ancillary failures
scope: Enumerate folder by folder, recording inaccessible subtrees and continuing accessible siblings.
Define the default link/reparse-point policy as skip-and-report; resolve root aliases safely before traversal.
Expose log-write/timestamp failures and cancellation-safe reporting fallbacks; never hide an incomplete scan.
acceptance: One denied subtree does not terminate the entire batch.
Junction/symlink loops are not followed.
Log and timestamp failures are visible and affect the documented outcome.

tasks.title: Bound processing and own native process lifetime
scope: Add practical per-file runtime and ImageMagick memory/temp-disk limits that respect stricter installed policies.
Implement a native-process wrapper that drains both streams without deadlocks and terminates only the process tree it started.
Check current upstream ImageMagick security notices, including the jpeg:extent hang advisory; use bounded synthetic timeout tests rather than malicious input.
acceptance: A stalled decoder/encoder cannot hang the entire batch forever.
No task kills unrelated magick processes or changes global policy.
Exhaustion/timeouts are classified and owned temporary data stays contained.

tasks.title: Implement and test clean cooperative cancellation
scope: Handle a user cancellation request, stop starting new items and terminate owned in-flight work.
Retain validated completed files and remove only known owned incomplete files where cleanup is possible.
Produce an interrupted-run record; distinguish cooperative Ctrl+C from terminal/process force-termination limitations.
acceptance: No canceled partial image/video is presented as a complete final output.
Unrelated files/processes are untouched.
Actual PS5.1/PS7 and batch-wrapper interrupt outcomes are recorded; limitations are not hidden.

tasks.title: Reconcile counts and add useful safe reports
scope: Count ignored files at discovery, track inaccessible directories separately and partition discovered file outcomes accurately.
Add duration, image-only input/output bytes, size-target warnings, renamed mappings and retained duplicate links.
Add a formula-safe local CSV report with relative paths; escape hostile text and report output/log-write failures.
acceptance: Counters reconcile without double-counting warning flags or pretending to know files in unreadable folders.
CSV filenames cannot become spreadsheet formulas; quoting alone is not the mitigation.
Video bytes and ignored/duplicate bytes are not falsely credited as image compression savings.

tasks.title: Propagate exit codes and harden the batch launcher
scope: Implement the documented complete, warning/partial, setup/global-error and controlled-cancellation exit contract.
Capture and return the script code before echo/pause changes it; keep the familiar pause for drag-and-drop.
Reject extra dropped folders clearly, preserve literal arguments, and keep the current host choice unless explicitly changed.
acceptance: Launcher messages match actual outcomes and exit codes survive the pause.
Single-directory drag-and-drop works on actual Windows.
No global execution-policy or security-setting change is introduced.

tasks.title: Complete Windows compatibility, static checks and security CI
scope: Expand the Windows PS5.1/PS7 matrix to the full mandatory corpus, including missing-codec negative tests and real codec-enabled runs.
Add scoped PSScriptAnalyzer rules, versioned development dependencies and hardened read-only CI permissions.
Record exact runner/OS versions; separate Windows desktop manual tests from Windows Server CI and Linux experiments.
acceptance: No mandatory test can silently pass by being skipped or discovering zero tests.
CI artifacts refer to exact tested commits and contain synthetic data only.
No pull_request_target checkout of untrusted code with write privileges, broad secrets, or fake action SHA pins.

tasks.title: Obtain owner acceptance of the familiar workflow
scope: Prepare the owner checklist and concrete comparison evidence without using private images in the repository.
Have the owner run the unchanged everyday launch flow with approved disposable copies on Windows.
Record approval or requested changes with tested commit; do not approve subjective image quality or default changes on the owner’s behalf.

Perform only the explicitly authorized D36 HDRI colour repair: clamp converted sRGB before white composition, verify T036 and full PS5.1/PS7 gates with separately bound HDRI colour runs, then prepare a short guided owner recheck. No new defaults or M4 work.
acceptance: Actual owner approval and Windows smoke evidence exist before public-release readiness is claimed.
Any requested material change returns to a bounded tested task.
A pending owner gate is reported as pending, not complete.
tasks.blocked_reason: D36 bounded HDRI repair passed full portable PS5.1/PS7 gates/controls/analyzer, separately verified installed-HDRI colour runs and CI at 5a32fc6533c6f9fae1d36c271b515d1d1dd4d8ad. Fresh one-image owner recheck and explicit named-commit acceptance remain pending.

tasks.title: Add one version source and release notes
scope: Choose a truthful first managed release version after reviewing existing tags; do not assume earlier versions exist.
Use one version source in log/help/package metadata and write a changelog distinguishing fixes, default safeguards and limitations.
Document supported/tested environments and third-party requirements.
acceptance: The same version appears throughout generated artifacts.
No tag or release is created during this task.
MIT license text and original authorship remain intact.

tasks.title: Build a portable release ZIP from reviewed tracked content
scope: Add a whitelist-driven release build containing matching entry points, necessary support files, legal notices and a short getting-started guide.
Exclude tests, governance, raw media, credentials and build debris; build from the intended clean revision.
Generate SHA-256 sums, inspect extraction and smoke-test in a new directory with spaces; record reproducibility claims precisely.
acceptance: ZIP contents match the allowlist and correspond to the recorded revision.
Downloaded/blocked-file and dependency instructions do not disable machine-wide controls.
No ImageMagick installer/binary is silently bundled or downloaded at runtime.

tasks.title: Publish-ready documentation for behavior and limitations
scope: Rewrite README/quick start around the existing workflow with tested examples, failure messages and size-unit clarity.
Document metadata/privacy, copied-video metadata, frame/page omission, heuristic dedupe, cloud-synced Pictures and the unsafe-nesting rule.
Add a lightweight security/reporting policy without invented contact addresses or signature claims.
acceptance: Every public behavior claim matches code/tests.
Documentation includes real prerequisites and distinguishes lossy derivatives from backups.
All download/version examples are either real or clearly held as unpublished drafts.

tasks.title: Prepare website content and download metadata, not a backend
scope: Prepare framework-neutral product copy, metadata fields and a simple website integration handoff.
Use the repository’s existing icon/poster and actual approved screenshots/comparisons; do not fabricate a UI or before/after.
Connect planned download metadata to versioned GitHub Release assets only after they exist; leave deployment to the website’s own approved workflow.
acceptance: No upload form, processing API, server-side conversion or runtime account requirement is introduced.
No assumed website domain, framework or hosting service is invented.
Unpublished URLs remain clearly non-live rather than broken public download buttons.

tasks.title: Audit the complete release candidate
scope: Review the full improvement diff and reconcile requirements with tasks, cases, CI and owner evidence.
Build and smoke-test the release candidate from the reviewed revision; verify ZIP hash, license and source provenance.
Prepare exact proposed merge/tag/release actions for owner approval; do not execute them.
acceptance: No unresolved critical safety defect or falsely completed test remains.
Release candidate approval names a specific implementation revision and artifact hash.
Feature branch is synchronized, CI is explicitly recorded and default branch remains untouched.

tasks.title: Perform only explicitly approved publication operations
scope: Verify the owner’s recorded approval identifies the exact merge target, version, artifact and permitted operations.
Execute only approved merge/tag/release actions; revalidate the actual post-merge/tag revision and release artifact when its identity changes.
Update download metadata only with verified public assets. Website deployment requires its own explicit approval and repository context.
acceptance: No approval is inferred from the original request to create a bundle.
Public tag/source, release ZIP and website metadata agree.
Local/default-branch synchronization after publication uses a safe clean fast-forward or stops on conflict.
